items.deep_read_zh:
View this post on the web at https://opinionai.substack.com/p/the-6-stages-of-getting-really-good

If I were learning AI from scratch today, I wouldn’t waste weeks watching tutorials or collecting hundreds of prompts. There’s much more worth learning now, especially with GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, and the new agent tools. I’ve narrowed it down to six stages that I think are actually worth your time. We’ll get into the useful features people often miss, how to build things without coding, give AI access to your tools, create your own skills, and make automations work. I’ve included the prompts, instructions, and resources for each stage, so you can try everything yourself rather than just read about it.
Here’s the order I would follow.
Stage 1
First, Understand What You Are Actually Using
